findings.claim: The test named 'refund on a reclaimed payout adopts a transfer before cancellation' never reaches the new re-claim + refund take-over branch in transferOne (lib/payouts/transfers.mjs:179-191); it passes through cancelRefunded's first loop instead, so that money-safety branch has no test that would fail without it.
findings.evidence: Test sets the row to status='failed', attempts=1, refund_seen_at set. transferOwed runs cancelRefunded (transfers.mjs:75-110) before step 4; its first query selects exactly failed rows with attempts>0 and a refund, finds the transfer and writes paid + refunded_after_payout. transferOne is never claimed for this row. payouts-money.test.mjs:177-212 also goes through cancelRefunded. No test puts a refunded payout into status='transferring' with an expired lease, which is the only state that reaches transfers.mjs:179-191. Deleting lines 180-191 keeps every test green.
findings.fix: Add a DB test: payout 'transferring', attempts=1, lease_until in the past, an existing fake transfer with metadata.payout_id, refund_seen_at set. Run transferOwed and assert paid + manual_reason='refunded_after_payout' + transfers.create count 0. Add a second variant with no transfer and assert 'cancelled'.

findings.claim: The spec's one-line 'Wypłaty gotowe' status with a link to /mentor/payouts (shown once the account is ready, OQ9 and Architecture '/mentor') is not implemented, so a ready mentor has no payouts entry point anywhere in the UI.
findings.evidence: The notice slot renders only `payoutSummary?.askForPayouts ? <PayoutSetupPrompt …/> : null` and NoAvailabilityNotice. A grep for 'Wypłaty gotowe' and '/mentor/payouts' in app/ and packages/ui/src finds only MentorPayouts.tsx:77 and the prompt's TextLink, which is hidden once the account is ready. MentorNav has no payouts item (spec: unchanged).
findings.fix: When summary.accountState === 'ready' (or any account exists and askForPayouts is false), render a small DS one-liner such as StatusText 'Wypłaty gotowe' + TextLink to /mentor/payouts in the notice slot. Add a story for it and an E2E assertion after onboarding returns.

findings.claim: In transferOne's refund branch, a failed take-over lookup falls through to 'cancelled' even when an earlier ambiguous attempt may have created a transfer. cancelRefunded (line 96-97) skips the row in the same situation, so the two paths are inconsistent, and only a later transfer.created webhook can repair the row.
findings.evidence: Lines 182-186: on a findExistingTransfer error the code only logs a warning, then lines 192-196 cancel the payout. In cancelRefunded the same error does `continue` and the row stays failed for a later take-over.
findings.fix: On a lookup error in the refund branch, return a failed or skipped result without cancelling (for example writeFailure with the same key, or leave the lease to expire), matching cancelRefunded's conservative behaviour.

findings.claim: The E2E does not prove the spec assertion 'Wypłacone do tej pory: 135 zł': both UI checks would pass with paidMinor = 0.
findings.evidence: Line 186 waits for the label 'Wypłacone do tej pory', which is always rendered (MentorPayouts.tsx:198). Line 187 matches /135\s?zł/ anywhere in <main>, and the paid list row for the session already shows 135 zł regardless of the total. Only the DB row is checked for 'paid'. The 390 px viewport is used, but no horizontal-overflow check is made.
findings.fix: Assert the DescriptionList value next to 'Wypłacone do tej pory', for example a locator scoped to the dd after that dt with toHaveText /135\s?zł/, and assert 'Do wypłaty' shows 0 zł. Optionally assert scrollWidth <= clientWidth at 390 px.

findings.claim: The OQ4 rule 'abandon the attempt without writing when less than 2 min of the lease remain before transfers.create' has no test.
findings.evidence: No test in tests/db/payouts-*.test.mjs advances deps.now between the claim and the create, and grep finds no 120_000 or remaining-lease scenario. Every test uses a fixed deps.now, so the branch at lines 232-234 never runs.
findings.fix: Add a DB test whose deps.now returns the claim time on the first call and claim+14 min afterwards. Assert zero transfers.create calls, the row still 'transferring' with attempts=1, and a later run (after lease expiry) creating exactly one transfer with the same key.

findings.claim: Two spec edge cases have no test: 'accounts.create … no-response → same key', and 'two concurrent onboarding clicks … a request insert for that mentor is not blocked meanwhile'. 'Payments not configured → page shows DB state, button {ok:false}' is also untested.
findings.evidence: The only accounts.create failure injected is a 500 (line 37-52). No ETIMEDOUT case for accounts.create exists in any payouts test, no test inserts a request while onboarding holds the advisory lock, and no test calls the server wrappers without payments config.
findings.fix: Add: (a) accounts.create fail with an ETIMEDOUT error without statusCode, assert create_key_version stays 1 and the retry sends the same idempotencyKey; (b) hold startOnboarding inside a delayed fake accounts.create and concurrently create a paid request for the same mentor, assert it completes; (c) a unit test that startCurrentPayoutOnboarding / startOnboarding without Stripe deps returns { ok: false }.

findings.claim: The page drops the currency of each item, so a session paid in another currency than the mentor page currency is listed with the wrong currency. The new currency-scoped totals intentionally keep such items in summary.items.
findings.evidence: summary.mjs:39 keeps item.currency, and payouts-onboarding.test.mjs:171-172 asserts an EUR item is present. page.tsx:41-55 maps items without currency, and MentorPayouts.tsx:241 renders every row with the page-level `currency` prop.
findings.fix: Add currency to PayoutSession and pass item.currency, rendering <Amount currency={s.currency}>. Alternatively, filter items to the summary currency in getPayoutSummary, consistent with the totals.

findings.claim: Return-notice wording contradicts itself for ?stripe=refresh with details submitted, and the spec's 'a story for each status' is incomplete.
findings.evidence: For returnFrom='interrupted' the HostedReturnNotice title is 'Na stronie Stripe nie wszystko zostało dokończone — dokończ, żeby kontynuować', but the detailsSubmitted body says 'Stripe sprawdza teraz podane dane…'. The Narrow story (stories line 152) renders exactly this combination because detailsSubmitted defaults to true (line 110). MentorPayouts.stories.tsx has no story with a 'transferring' session. The final branch at lines 209-214 is unreachable (actionLabel is null only for 'ready'), and its comment no longer describes the behaviour.
findings.fix: For interrupted + detailsSubmitted pass a matching title (e.g. 'Stripe sprawdza dane') or use the attention body only. Default detailsSubmitted to false. Add a 'transferring' story. Remove the dead branch.

findings.claim: JSDoc contains Cyrillic words ('база, клиент Stripe'), and the language of comments and JSDoc is mixed English/Polish across the new modules.
findings.evidence: accounts.mjs:76 `@param {any} deps база, клиент Stripe, zegar i logger`. transfers.mjs:312, 443 and 479 and webhook.mjs onRefundSeen/onTransferCreated are in English, while neighbouring modules use Polish.
findings.fix: Replace with 'baza, klient Stripe, zegar i logger' and align the new JSDoc with the module's language.

findings.claim: The migration has no header comment, unlike 0005 and 0008, which explain the purpose, guarded transitions and the down-refusal rationale.
findings.evidence: File starts directly with '-- Up Migration'. 0005_payments.sql:1-7 has a descriptive header.
findings.fix: Add a short Polish header citing spec 2026-11-09, the money invariants (unique request_id, paid ⇒ transfer id), application-set updated_at, and why down refuses.
